name: Ancestral Wand
note: The Ancestral wand is a power level 8 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 magic logs, 5 harmonised compound, 2 vis cloth, 2 dragonstone, and 2 draconic vis wax.

name: Ash Battlestaff
note: The ash battlestaff is a power level 2 magic weapon. It can be created at a crafting table using 12 ash logs, 6 rune essence, and 2 coarse thread.

name: Ash Shortbow
note: Ash shortbow is a power level 2 Shortbow that can be crafted at a Crafting Table.

name: Ash Wand
note: The Ash wand is a power level 2 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a crafting table using 6 ash logs, 3 rune essence, and 1 coarse thread.

name: Black Greataxe
note: The black greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bloodstained hilt, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments, or acquired from chest (dowdun reach).

name: Black Sword
note: The black sword is a one-handed power level 6 melee weapon. The recipe is unlocked after studying the shattered black blade vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Blightwood Battlestaff
note: Blightwood battlestaff is a power level 4 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

name: Blightwood Longbow
note: Blightwood longbow is a power level 4 Longbows that can be crafted at the fletching bench, once the recipe is unlocked by cutting and picking up blightwood and swamp thread.

name: Blightwood Shortbow
note: The blightwood shortbow is a power level 4 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Blightwood Wand
note: The Blightwood wand is a power level 4 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 blightwood, 3 wild anima, 2 swamp thread, and 2 vault shard.

name: Blurite Bolts
note: Blurite bolts are power level 4 ammunition that can be fired with a blurite crossbow or higher. They are crafted at a fletching bench after unlocking the recipe with the vestige: azure metal contraption.

name: Blurite Crossbow
note: The blurite crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned after studying the azure metal contraption found in a chest in northwest Fractured Plains.

name: Bone Bolts
note: Bone bolts are a power level 5 ammunition that can only be fired from Dorgeshuun crossbows. Bone bolts are unlocked after completing the quest, Even More Restless Ghosts.

name: Bone Club
note: The bone club is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

name: Bone Dagger
note: The bone dagger is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

name: Bow of Elidinis
note: The bow of Elidinis is a power level 7 masterwork longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is received as a reward for completing the Mapping The Sands II quest.

name: Bronze Arrow
note: Bronze arrows are power level 3 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Bronze Barbed Arrow
note: Bronze barbed arrows are bronze arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Targets that are hit by a bronze barbed arrow will be inflicted with the bleed debuff.

name: Bronze Bolts
note: Bronze bolts are a power level 3 ammunition that can be fired from bronze crossbows.

name: Bronze Crossbow
note: A bronze crossbow is a power level 3 Crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Bronze Dagger
note: The bronze dagger is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

name: Bronze Fire Arrow
note: Bronze fire arrows are bronze arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by a bronze fire arrow will be inflicted with the burning debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds.

name: Bronze Greatsword
note: The bronze greatsword is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

name: Bronze Mace
note: The bronze mace is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

name: Bronze Sword
note: The bronze sword is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

name: Bronze Warhammer
note: The bronze warhammer is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that is crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

name: Chieftain's Blade
note: The chieftain's blade is a power level 3 one-handed weapon, created by combining 10 bronze bars, 2 antlers, and 2 animal bones at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige a corroded serrated blade, found in a chest atop the same plateau where you start the Heartstrings quest.

name: Crystal Bow
note: The crystal bow is a power level 3 masterwork shortbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Heartstrings quest. It can then be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Dorgeshuun Crossbow
note: The dorgeshuun crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is obtained from the quest Even More Restless Ghosts.

name: Draconic Staff
note: The draconic staff is a power level 4 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the parts of a sinister-looking staff, which can be found in a chest on the western wall outside of Skeklac Kara, the dragonkin vault in Ashien's Watch.

name: Dragon Crossbow
note: The Dragon crossbow is a power level 9 ranged weapon that can be received after completing the Scorned Wilderness raid and opening the Queenslayer's Reward Pack. Unlike many other weapons in the game, this crossbow is both uncraftable and has a passive full durability.

name: Dragon Scimitar
note: The dragon scimitar is a Power level 9 weapon that can be received after completing the Scorned Wilderness raid and opening the Queenslayer's Reward Pack. Unlike many other weapons in the game, this scimitar is both uncraftable and has a passive full durability.

name: Dragonbone Dagger
note: The dragonbone dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, the dragonkin vault in northwest Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Enchanted Adamant Bolt
note: The Enchanted Adamant Bolt is a power level 7 bolt crafted at a Fletching Bench. It has a 15% chance to drain 15% of the user's current health and increase critical hit damage by 40% for that shot on a successful hit.

name: Enchanted Blurite Bolts
note: Enchanted blurite bolts are an upgradeable version of blurite bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. Upon creation, there is a 15% chance of the stack of bolts being enchanted with 10% earth magic damage.

name: Enchanted Bronze Bolts
note: Enchanted bronze bolts are an upgradeable version of bronze bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. Upon creation, there is a 15% chance of the stack of bolts being enchanted with 10% air magic damage and up to 16 damage towards the enemy via the Shocked debuff.

name: Enchanted Iron Bolts
note: Enchanted iron bolts are an upgradeable version of iron bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. After creation, there is a 15% chance of one of the bolts being enchanted with 10% water magic damage.

name: Enchanted Mithril Bolts
note: Enchanted mithril bolts are a power level 6 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench that has a 15% chance to create a toxic burst, poisoning all nearby enemies within a 4-5 meter radius.

name: Enchanted Rune Bolt
note: Enchanted rune bolts are a power level 8 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench. It has a 15% chance to increase critical hit damage by 20% for that shot on a successful hit.

name: Enchanted Steel Bolts
note: Enchanted steel bolts are a power level 5 ammunition that has a 15% chance to heal 20% of the player's health when struck at an enemy.

name: Fang Arrow
note: Fang arrows are power level 2 ammunition crafted at a Crafting Table.

name: Fang Barbed Arrow
note: Fang barbed arrows are fang arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a Bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

name: Fang Fire Arrow
note: Fang fire arrows are fang arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by the fang fire arrow will not be inflicted with the Burning debuff, but higher-tier arrows will have a higher chance of doing so.

name: Goblin "Swingslash"
note: The goblin "Swingslash" is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming a cruel goblin blade, received as a random drop from a goblin pack; the drop chance for this vestige is 2%.

name: Granite Maul

name: Grieving Moonstaff

name: Hunter Stagbow

name: Thane's Authority
note: Thane's authority is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a brutal bladehead, received randomly as a drop from killing garou thanes and the Garou King, at a 1/20 drop chance.

name: Titan's Wrath

note: The zombie arm is a power level 4 melee weapon that is awarded to the player after completing The Great Body Robbery, and can then be crafted using a blacksmith's bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

name: Zombie Axe
note: The zombie axe is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The axe and its recipe are received by completing Doric's Quest.
